meta.name: gdrive_synthesize
meta.description: Synthesize durable KTX wiki pages from staged Google Drive document pulls. Load when a WorkUnit contains Google Doc raw files from `docs/**`.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将Google文档内容合成持久化知识库页面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把Google Drive中的文档整理成结构化知识页面
copy.tagline_en: Synthesize Google Drive documents into durable knowledge pages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn Google Drive documents into structured wiki pages

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能读取 Google Drive 文档，提取其中的公司知识（如政策、流程、术语），并写入持久的 wiki 页面。它会优先更新已有页面，避免重复。
howto.when: 当工作单元中包含来自 `docs/**` 路径的 Google Drive 原始文件时触发。通常是在用户要求处理 Google Drive 文档并生成知识库时。

say.text: 请处理这个 Google Drive 文档，提取关键政策。
say.note: Claude 会读取文档并写入 wiki。

say.text: 更新 wiki 中关于数据仓库命名规范的内容。
say.note: Claude 会搜索现有 wiki 并更新。

say.text: 对比这两个 Google Doc，找出冲突点。
say.note: Claude 会读取并写入冲突注释。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can read Google Drive documents, extract reusable company knowledge (policies, workflows, terminology), and write durable wiki pages. It prefers updating existing pages over creating duplicates.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a WorkUnit contains Google Drive raw files from the `docs/**` path. Typically when a user asks to process Google Drive documents and generate knowledge base entries.

say_en.text: Process this Google Drive doc and extract key policies.
say_en.note: Claude reads the doc and writes wiki entries.

say_en.text: Update the wiki page on data warehouse naming conventions.
say_en.note: Claude searches existing wiki and updates.

say_en.text: Compare these two Google Docs and find conflicts.
say_en.note: Claude reads both and writes conflict notes.
